questions_and_answers.question_text: पिछले वर्ष उस देश में क्या हो रहा था?

answers.answer_text: What was happening in that country last year?

questions_and_answers.question_text: उन दिनों आप क्या कर रहे थे?

answers.answer_text: What were you doing in those days?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या वे सब लड़कियाँ टेनिस खेलना सीख रही थीं?

answers.answer_text: Were all those girls learning to play tennis?

questions_and_answers.question_text: उनसे पूछिये कि वे पिछले साल इन दिनों क्या कर रहे थे?

answers.answer_text: Ask them what they were doing at this time last year.

questions_and_answers.question_text: आप उस कंपनी में कब से काम कर रहे थे?

answers.answer_text: Since when had you been working in that company?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या वे पिछले साल भी उस बड़ी इमारत में रह रहे थे?

answers.answer_text: Were they living in that big building last year too?
